utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The old porch steps are the worst right now, if we can start there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Okay, I can help with the porch steps first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but we should figure out the timing and who’s bringing what first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm what time you’re thinking and whether you want me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: How about around 3 if that works? Please bring the tape and the spare screws, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive — I must’ve missed the update. What changed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, not much—just a few more things got added for the repair drive, and I’m trying to keep track of it all. I can fill you in if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please do — I’m a bit behind and could use the quick version.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help spread the word about the repair drive. Let me tell a few neighbors and make sure they know the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be a big help, Vik. I really appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll let a few neighbors know and keep the time and place straight. Glad to help out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going? Did we get many people to show up?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: A few folks have stopped by, yeah—nothing huge, but enough to keep us busy. If you’ve got a minute, we could still use an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I can help for a bit—where do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to know the plan first—what time are we meeting, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re meeting at 9 AM by the community center, and if you can bring work gloves and a screwdriver, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—I’ll be there at 9 with gloves and a screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, have you decided which repair item you’re bringing to the drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m bringing a box of light bulbs for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks—are they all working bulbs, or should I label the box?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad we’re doing this repair drive—there are a few folks I can check in with, and maybe I can help connect the groups. What do you need me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you start by checking who still needs to pick up supplies and which households are easiest to reach first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check who still needs supplies and map out the easiest households to reach first. I’ll report back with a quick list so we can split things up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara—could you help me make a quick list of the needed repairs and then check which neighbors can pitch in? That would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll make the repair list and check with the neighbors who can help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what we’ve got and note any missing supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—just jot down anything we’re short on and I’ll help fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do—I’ll make a quick list of anything we’re low on and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s been picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and a few cash donations too. I heard Manny might be bringing over his pickup this afternoon if we still need help moving the bigger stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s great to hear. If Manny comes by, we could really use the extra help with the heavier stuff.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep an eye out and let you know as soon as he shows up. If he brings the pickup, we should be in good shape for the heavy pieces.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the details for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I can help with that. What part do you need, the date, drop-off location, or what items they’re accepting?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: The date and drop-off location would help most, and I’d like to know what items they’re accepting too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help out with the repair drive. Just point me to what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Bo — that’s really helpful. I’ll let you know what needs doing as soon as I hear the latest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing—just send it over when you know. I’ll jump in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and mention it to folks around the block.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that’d be a big help. I really appreciate you spreading the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive to folks around the block.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I’m a bit behind—did something change about it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, not really—just checking in. It’s still on, but I don’t have all the details yet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks—just let me know when you have the details. I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly I could use help sorting the tool table and lending a hand with small fixes. If you’re free, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with that. Just let me know when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal, I’m glad we’re getting this repair drive going. I’m putting the list together now so we can make sure nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll keep track of who’s bringing what and where everything should go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Opal. I’ll send around the updated list and we can fill in any gaps together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I need to know the exact drop-off time and what you still need moved so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — the drop-off is at 10:00 AM, and we still need a few boxes, a folding chair, and some tools moved over. Thank you again for helping out!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me—please send the exact address too, and I’ll plan to be there a little early.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still on for today, right? I just want to make sure before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check the details before I say for sure, but I believe it’s still on today. I’ll confirm and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, I’d appreciate that. Just send me a quick confirm once you know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple—what time are we heading out for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m running a bit late as usual—what time are you all heading out?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No problem—how about we leave at 3:00?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive's getting set up—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell—if you can bring any spare tape, screws, or a screwdriver, that’d help a lot. I’ll keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can check my toolbox for tape, screws, and a screwdriver and bring whatever I find.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out, even if I might need a reminder or two about the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren—that’s kind of you. I’ll remind you with the details closer to the drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara. Just give me the details when it’s closer, and I’ll do my best to show up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive—what time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Morning works best for me, maybe around 9. I can help with setup before the kids get out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9 sounds good to me, and I can help get things lined up before school lets out. Let me know what setup you need me to handle.
